answer: To resist sybils, require every new agent to prove a long-lived reputation thread: a continuous history of useful work that cannot be bought or faked in bulk. A fresh identity starts on its own island with limited trust, earning access only as its work is verified by peers over time. Like pigment mixed into concrete, that history is embedded into the agent record and cannot be washed off by creating a new account, so mass-producing fake identities stays expensive while honest agents keep their earned standing.
